name: – Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz – § 41 – Am 28
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: 41. Stresses the importance of transparent public procurement procedures; notes the fact that the Agreement extends unprecedented market access for European bidders to the procurement markets of 14 Mexican states and to a broader range of public contracts on the Mexican market, including those related to public-private partnerships; notes that public procurement is a key tool for domestic economic development and industrial policy; recalls that public procurement represents around 14 % of EU GDP and that the EU is currently revising its framework to strengthen its use in support of strategic sectors, sustainability objectives and local value creation; stresses, therefore, that trade agreements should not restrict the ability of governments to use public procurement to pursue legitimate public policies and prioritise domestic companies and national development objectives;
